rightfiber.headline: A larger regional fiber platform built for what comes next.
points: Expands the combined fiber network to more than 28,000 route miles.
Grows the state footprint from 13 states to 20 states.
Combines two trusted local providers with shared values and complementary strengths.
Scales service across more than 400 communities while preserving local relationships and support.

agenda.headline: Thank you for the conversation. Here are the next steps.
items: Discussed strategic priorities and current environment.
Follow up on site requirements and connectivity options.
Schedule time with key technical stakeholders.
Share Rightfiber / Ritter Communications merger update and expanded fiber footprint.

cards.title: Enterprise Lifecycle Management
points: Dedicated end-to-end account ownership from discovery through post-install support.
Solution design and implementation management aligned with long-term business goals.
Strategic roadmap development for redundancy, scalability and future network evolution.

cards.title: 24/7/365 Network Operations Center
points: Continuous monitoring, rapid incident response and proactive maintenance.
Operational continuity support for trading, scheduling, settlement and customer-facing systems.
Private Layer 2 and wavelength options for resilient critical-workflow transport.

cards.title: Local Technical Engagement
points: Omaha and regional engineering engagement for high-touch technical planning.
Localized field technician support for troubleshooting, maintenance and rapid escalation.
Responsive account management grounded in GPC's regional operating footprint.

cards.title: Strategic Regional Presence
points: Core technical facilities and support hubs positioned across the Midwest.
Direct data center and cloud connectivity options for sensitive operational traffic.
400G-ready backbone capacity for large-load customers, project sites and future demand.
